_about: Wallets found off Kolscan (GMGN smart-money board) that passed Rage's full checklist in a fresh check. The scanner treats each 'follow' entry as if it were on the Kolscan 30-day board with the record below, so it goes through the same scorecard and strict rules as every other wallet (win rate, profit, size, pace, rug-heavy check on the bot's own data, losing copies). An entry stops counting 14 days after 'checked' unless it is re-checked. 'watch' entries are notes only: they are not followed.

follow.name: GsbH (GMGN)
follow.note: Fresh check from its last 20 days of GMGN activity: 12 of 21 closed coins won (57%; GMGN's own 30-day figure 52%, 7-day 69%), about +$4,360 realized (+$841 in 7 days), 1.4 new coins a day, median buy about $247, median hold about 17 hours, no sells within 60 seconds of a buy, no coin lost over half, 1 of 8 checked coins down 25%+ an hour after its buy. Coins mostly in pools of $36k to $2M. DEX mix of 28 coins: PumpSwap 19, Raydium 4, Orca 4, Meteora 1.
